prompt: Build for this brief: A cultural venue; visitors browse works, plan visits and find events. Use Spectrum 2-1: page #FAF9FB, text #2D1F2C, accent #861D24, secondary surface #EDEFE7, text on accent #FFFFFF. Set headings in Poppins and reading text in Libre Baskerville; geometric heading with a contrasting reading serif. Composition: Single reading column, left aligned headings, marginal metadata, thin section rules. Use body 16px, heading 36px, line height 1.45, reading measure at most 56ch, gap 24px, content width at most 1440px and item radius 8px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
